# Svg 动态渲染，拖拽缩放实现

# Svg 动态渲染

假设从后端接口获取到 svg 的文本字符串，可将文本字符串解析成 DOM 进行渲染，下面的函数接受 svg 文本作为参数

function stringToXml(xmlString) {
  try {
    let xmlDoc;
    if (typeof xmlString == 'string') {
      if (document.implementation.createDocument) {
        let parser = new DOMParser();
        xmlDoc = parser.parseFromString(xmlString, 'text/xml');
      } else if (window.ActiveXObject) {
        xmlDoc = new ActiveXObject('Microsoft.XMLDOM');
        xmlDoc.async = false;
        xmlDoc.loadXML(xmlString);
      }
      const svgNodes = xmlDoc.documentElement.children;
      xmlDoc.documentElement.id = props.svgId;
      xmlDoc.documentElement.style.width = `${svgDom.value.clientWidth}px`;
      xmlDoc.documentElement.style.height = `${svgDom.value.clientHeight}px`;
      xmlDoc.documentElement.setAttribute(
        'viewBox',
        `0 0 ${svgDom.value.clientWidth} ${svgDom.value.clientHeight}`,
      );
      // 遍历节点
      Array.from(svgNodes).forEach((node) => {
          // 节点操作
      });
    }
    const rootGroup = document.createElementNS(
      'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg',
      'g',
    );
    const rootGroupId = 'rootGroup';
    rootGroup.setAttribute('id', rootGroupId);
    rootGroup.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
      const target = event.target;
      if (target.tagName === 'svg') return; // Ignore clicks on the root svg element
      handleNodeClick(target.id);
    });
    // 将svg中的节点统一放到g节点中
    while (xmlDoc.documentElement.firstChild) {
      rootGroup.appendChild(xmlDoc.documentElement.firstChild);
    }
    // 再将g节点挂载到xmlDoc
    xmlDoc.documentElement.appendChild(rootGroup);
    // 这里的svgDom为svg容器，将xmlDoc挂载到svg容器中
    svgDom.value.appendChild(xmlDoc.documentElement);
    // 获取刚才挂载的g节点
    gDom = document.getElementById(rootGroupId);
    // 给g节点添加移动缩放事件
    svgAction = new SvgAction(gDom, {
      range: {
        min: 0.001,
        max: 10,
      },
    });
    svgAction.zoom('center');
  } catch (error) {
    console.log('svg render error --> ', error);
  }
}

# svgAction.js-缩放移动实现

let DEG_ELEMENT;
/**
 * 给svg添加放大缩小的功能
 */
const defaultOption = {
  threshold: 15, // 鼠标超过多少才移动
  deltaThreshold: 0.1, // 每次放大比例
  range: {
    min: 0.4,
    max: 100,
  }, // 可缩放倍数
  scale: 0.1, // 每次缩放比例
  stepSize: 75, // ctrl | shift + 鼠标滚轮每次移动的像素
  keyStepSize: 10, // 键盘或调用移动方法时默认步长
  mouseScale: true, // 滚轮缩放
  mouseMove: true, // 平移
  mouseDrag: true, // 拖动
  mouseRotate: false, // 旋转
  mouseFlip: false, // 翻转
  useKeyControl: false,
};
/**
 * @param {Object} options
 * @param {Number} options.threshold 指定鼠标拖动时起始阈值，默认：15
 * @param {Number} options.deltaThreshold 最小放大比例，默认：0.1
 * @param {Object} options.range
 * @param {Number} options.range.min 最小缩放倍数，默认：0.25
 * @param {Number} options.range.max 最大缩放倍数，默认：100
 * @param {Number} options.scale 每次缩放比例，默认：0.25
 * @param {Number} options.stepSize ctrl | shift + 鼠标滚轮每次移动的像素 默认75
 * @param {Number} options.keyStepSize 键盘或调用移动方法时默认步长，默认10
 * @param {Element} options.mouseControl 设置鼠标控制节点，默认svg节点父级document
 * @param {Boolean} options.mouseScale 是否开启鼠标缩放，默认true
 * @param {Boolean} options.mouseMove 否开启鼠标移动，按住Shift或Ctrl键 + 滚轮即可平移，默认true
 * @param {Boolean} options.mouseDrag 是否开启鼠标拖拽，默认true
 * @param {Boolean} options.mouseRotate 是否开启鼠标旋转，按住ctrl即可旋转，默认false
 * @param {Boolean} options.mouseFlip 是否开启鼠标翻转，按住Shift即可旋转，默认false
 * @param {Boolean} options.useKeyControl 是否开启键盘控制移动， 默认false
 * @param {Element} options.keyControl 设置键盘控制的节点，默认svg父级或document
 */

class SvgAction {
  constructor(svg, options) {
    if (!svg) throw new Error('Initialization failed, SVG not found!');
    this.disableMouseEvent = false;
    this._svg = svg;
    this.options = {
      ...defaultOption,
      ...options,
    };
    this.options.mouseControl = this.getControlElement();
    this.options.keyControl = this.getKeyElement();
    this._totalDelta = 0;
    this._previouScale = 1;
    this._deg = 0;
    this._init();
  }

  changeDisableMouseEvent() {
    this.disableMouseEvent = !this.disableMouseEvent;
  }

  _init() {
    this._initSvg();
    generateCss();
    this.buildEvent();
  }

  buildEvent() {
    if (this.eventState) {
      return;
    }
    this.eventState = true;
    buildMoveEvent.call(this);
    buildMousewheelEvent.call(this);
    if (this.options.useKeyControl) {
      buildKeyEvent.call(this);
    }
  }

  _initSvg() {
    this._svg.className.baseVal = 'move-cursor-grab';
    // 第一个子节点必须是g
    if (this._svg.tagName === 'g') {
      this._viewport = this._svg;
      this._svg = findSvg(this._viewport) || this._viewport;
      function findSvg(node) {
        if (node.parentElement.tagName == 'svg') {
          return node.parentElement;
        }
        return findSvg(node.parentElement);
      }
    }
  }

  zoomIn(i) {
    i = i || this.options.scale;
    this._zoom(1, getCentre.call(this), i);
  }

  zoomOut(i) {
    i = i || this.options.scale;
    this._zoom(-1, getCentre.call(this), i);
  }

  _zoom(delta, position, stepSize) {
    let direction = delta > 0 ? 1 : -1;
    let currentLinearZoomLevel = log10(this._previouScale);
    let newLinearZoomLevel =
      Math.round(currentLinearZoomLevel / stepSize) * stepSize;
    newLinearZoomLevel += stepSize * direction;
    let newLogZoomLevel = Math.pow(10, newLinearZoomLevel);
    setZoom.call(this, cap(this.options.range, newLogZoomLevel), position);
    this._previouScale = round(this._viewport.getCTM().a, 1000);
    return this._previouScale;
  }

  reset() {
    this.zoom('center');
  }

  zoom(delta, position) {
    if (!delta) {
      return round(this._viewport.getCTM().a, 1000);
    }
    let scale = this.options.scale;
    if (delta === 'center') {
      return this._fitViewport(delta);
    } else if (delta === 'in') {
      delta = 1;
    } else if (delta === 'out') {
      delta = -1;
    } else if (typeof delta == 'number') {
      scale = Math.abs(delta);
    } else {
      return round(this._viewport.getCTM().a, 1000);
    }
    this._totalDelta += delta;
    if (Math.abs(this._totalDelta) > this.options.deltaThreshold) {
      let i = this._zoom(delta, position, scale);
      this._totalDelta = 0;
      return i;
    }
  }

  _fitViewport(center) {
    let outer = {
      height: this._svg.clientHeight,
      width: this._svg.clientWidth,
    };
    let inner = this._viewport.getBBox();
    let newScale, newViewbox;
    if (
      inner.x >= 0 &&
      inner.y >= 0 &&
      inner.x + inner.width <= outer.width &&
      inner.y + inner.height <= outer.height &&
      !center
    ) {
      newViewbox = {
        x: 0,
        y: 0,
        width: Math.max(inner.width + inner.x, outer.width),
        height: Math.max(inner.height + inner.y, outer.height),
      };
    } else {
      // newScale = Math.min(1, outer.width / inner.width, outer.height / inner.height);
      newScale = Math.min(
        outer.width / inner.width,
        outer.height / inner.height,
      );
      let offsetX = -inner.x * newScale;
      let offsetY = -inner.y * newScale;
      let x = outer.width / 2 - (inner.width * newScale) / 2;
      let y = outer.height / 2 - (inner.height * newScale) / 2;
      newViewbox = {
        x: x >= 0 ? x + offsetX : offsetX,
        y: y >= 0 ? y + offsetY : offsetY,
      };
    }
    let newMatrix = this._svg
      .createSVGMatrix()
      .translate(newViewbox.x, newViewbox.y)
      .scale(newScale);
    setCTM(this._viewport, {
      matrix: newMatrix,
    });
    // 设置角度还原
    this._deg = 0;
    return (this._previouScale = round(this._viewport.getCTM().a, 1000));
  }

  move(delta) {
    let matrix = this._viewport.getCTM();
    if (delta) {
      delta.dx = delta.dx || delta.x || 0;
      delta.dy = delta.dy || delta.y || 0;
      delta = Object.assign(
        {
          dx: 0,
          dy: 0,
        },
        delta,
      );
      // 使用浏览器的api计算偏移距离
      matrix = this._svg
        .createSVGMatrix()
        .translate(delta.dx, delta.dy)
        .multiply(matrix);
      setCTM(this._viewport, {
        matrix,
      });
    }
    return {
      x: matrix.e,
      y: matrix.f,
    };
  }

  up(i) {
    i = i || this.options.keyStepSize;
    return this.move({
      dy: -i,
    });
  }

  down(i) {
    i = i || this.options.keyStepSize;
    return this.move({
      dy: i,
    });
  }

  left(i) {
    i = i || this.options.keyStepSize;
    return this.move({
      dx: -i,
    });
  }

  right(i) {
    i = i || this.options.keyStepSize;
    return this.move({
      dx: i,
    });
  }

  rotate(angle = 45) {
    let bbox = this._viewport.getBBox();
    setCTM(this._viewport, {
      rotate: {
        angle: angle,
        x: bbox.width / 2 + bbox.x,
        y: bbox.height / 2 + bbox.y,
      },
    });
    this._deg += angle;
  }

  flipX() {
    let ctm = this._viewport.getCTM();
    setCTM(this._viewport, {
      matrix: ctm.flipX(),
    });
  }

  getControlElement() {
    return this.options.mouseControl || this._svg.parentElement || document;
  }

  getKeyElement() {
    return this.options.keyControl || document;
  }

  toImage() {
    let image = new Image();
    let rect = this._svg.getBoundingClientRect();
    image.width = rect.width;
    image.height = rect.height;
    image.src = 'data:image/svg+xml;utf8,' + unescape(this._svg.outerHTML);
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      image.onload = function () {
        let canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        canvas.width = rect.width;
        canvas.height = rect.height;
        let context = canvas.getContext('2d');
        context.drawImage(image, 0, 0, rect.width, rect.height);
        resolve(canvas.toDataURL('image/png'));
      };
    });
  }

  save() {
    this.toImage().then((url) => {
      let a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      a.download = 'svg.png'; //设定下载名称
      a.click(); //点击触发下载
    });
  }

  disableEvent() {
    // 清空事件
    let ops = this.options;
    let eventFn = this._eventFn;
    let el = ops.mouseControl;
    this.eventState = false;
    el.removeEventListener('mousedown', eventFn.handleMousedown);
    el.removeEventListener('touchstart', eventFn.handleTouchstart);
    document.removeEventListener('mousemove', eventFn.handleMouseMove);
    document.removeEventListener('mouseup', eventFn.handleEnd);
    document.removeEventListener('touchmove', eventFn.handleMouseMove);
    document.removeEventListener('touchend', eventFn.handleEnd);
    el.removeEventListener('mousewheel', eventFn.handleMousewheel);
    ops.keyControl.removeEventListener('keydown', eventFn.handleKeydown);
  }
}

function stopBubble(event) {
  let e = event || window.event;
  if (e.preventDefault) {
    e.preventDefault();
  }
  // 一般用在鼠标或键盘事件上
  if (e.stopPropagation) {
    // W3C取消冒泡事件
    e.stopPropagation();
  } else {
    // IE取消冒泡事件
    window.event.cancelBubble = true;
  }
}

function transformPoint(svg, screenX, screenY) {
  let p = svg.createSVGPoint();
  p.x = screenX;
  p.y = screenY;
  return p.matrixTransform(svg.getScreenCTM().inverse());
}
/**
 * 添加图形移动事件
 */
function buildMoveEvent() {
  let self = this;
  let ops = self.options;
  let context = {};
  let el = ops.mouseControl;
  el.addEventListener('mousedown', handleMousedown, false);
  el.addEventListener('touchstart', handleTouchstart, {
    passive: false,
  });

  function handleMousedown(event) {
    // 开启拖拽
    context.start = toPoint(event); // 起始坐标
    self._svg.className.baseVal = 'move-cursor-grabbing';
    document.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove, false);
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', handleEnd, false);
  }

  function handleTouchstart(event) {
    stopBubble(event);
    context.start = toPoint(event); // 起始坐标
    document.addEventListener('touchmove', handleMouseMove, {
      passive: false,
    });
    document.addEventListener('touchend', handleEnd, {
      passive: false,
    });
    if (event.touches.length >= 2) {
      let fast = toPoint(event.touches[0]);
      let last = toPoint(event.touches[1]);
      let cente = getPointCentre(fast.x, fast.y, last.x, last.y);
      (cente = transformPoint(self._svg, cente.x, cente.y)),
        (context.doubleStart = {
          fast,
          last,
          cente,
          length: getDistance(fast.x, fast.y, last.x, last.y),
        });
    }
  }

  function handleMouseMove(event) {
    stopBubble(event);
    if (event.type == 'touchmove' && event.touches.length >= 2) {
      // 缩放
      let fast = toPoint(event.touches[0]);
      let last = toPoint(event.touches[1]);
      let doubleStart = context.doubleStart;
      // 计算距离
      let length = getDistance(fast.x, fast.y, last.x, last.y);
      if (length > doubleStart.length) {
        // 放大
        self._zoom(1, doubleStart.cente, 0.025);
      } else {
        // 缩小
        self._zoom(-1, doubleStart.cente, 0.025);
      }
      doubleStart.length = length;
      return;
    }
    context.position = toPoint(event); // 当前鼠标坐标
    context.delta = deltaPos(context.position, context.start); // 当前坐标到起始坐标的偏移
    // 鼠标移动超过15px才移动图形，防止晃动
    let fast = false;
    if (!context.dragging && _length(context.delta) > ops.threshold) {
      context.dragging = true;
      fast = true;
    }
    if (!context.dragging) {
      return;
    }
    if (ops.mouseRotate && event.ctrlKey) {
      handleRotate(event, fast);
    } else if (ops.mouseFlip && event.shiftKey) {
      handleFlip(event, fast);
    } else if (ops.mouseDrag) {
      handleMove(event, fast);
    }
    context.last = context.position; // 记录下最后一次移动的位置
  }
  // 处理拖拽
  function handleMove(event) {
    if (self.disableMouseEvent) {
      return;
    }
    let lastPosition = context.last || context.start;
    let delta = deltaPos(context.position, lastPosition);
    self.move({
      dx: delta.x,
      dy: delta.y,
    });
  }
  /**
   * 处理旋转
   * 按住Ctrl 加鼠标
   */
  function handleRotate(event, fast) {
    let degEl = degElement();
    // 鼠标移动超过15px才移动图形，防止晃动
    if (fast) {
      document.body.appendChild(degEl);
      degEl.show = true;
    }
    let lastPosition = context.last || context.start;
    let delta = deltaPos(context.position, lastPosition);
    let step = delta.x || delta.y;
    let deg = step < 0 ? -1 : 1;
    self.rotate(deg); // 没出触发旋转1度
    degEl.style.top = event.clientY + 'px';
    degEl.style.left = event.clientX + 20 + 'px';
    degEl.innerText = self._deg + '°';
  }
  /**
   * 处理翻转
   * 按住Shift 加鼠标
   */
  function handleFlip(event, fast) {
    if (!fast) {
      return;
    }
    if (context.delta.x >= ops.threshold) {
      // X 轴
      self.flipX();
    } else if (context.delta.x < ops.threshold) {
      //Y轴
      self.flipY();
    }
  }

  function handleEnd(event) {
    self._svg.className.baseVal = 'move-cursor-grab';
    context = {}; // 每一次移动结束，都清除上一次的结果
    document.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
    document.removeEventListener('mouseup', handleEnd);
    document.removeEventListener('touchmove', handleMouseMove);
    document.removeEventListener('touchend', handleEnd);
